desc: Minecraft-style title box, no lower captions. a: side on, the camera arcs in as the tiny boy rises on his toes and lifts the book. b (cut on 'Formula'): from behind the boy, up at the boss leaning down to take it.
Dennis takes the book and writes in it; the boy watches on tiptoe.
Insert: the page. 'Phone me in 9 years' appears word by word as it's spoken, then a made-up signature. No captions.
Home, night: the dad at the table with the bills and a nearly empty coin jar rubs his eyes with the heel of his hand; the boy watches from the doorway.
The shed: the fifth-hand club kart (library kart, battered), the whole kart in shot, three-quarter from the front.
a: the dad kneels and sands the side pod. b: the same kart fixed up like new; he stands back. Wide, the whole kart in shot.
Split screen, the dad's jobs: office desk (9:00); knocking a FOR SALE board into a front lawn with a mallet (18:00); scrubbing plates at a restaurant sink (23:00).
The kart track paddock: kids by their karts (library karts, team colours). He's the only Black kid.
The kids and parents turn their backs and walk away one by one. He stands alone, helmet in hand.
Closer and lighter: tears run down his cheeks, he wipes them with his glove, then straightens up as his dad comes.
His dad kneels, turned toward us, talking, a hand on his shoulder; on 'track' he points at the circuit. The boy nods.
Wide: visor down, the karts launch and he takes the inside line. The wheels roll.
Wide: his kart crosses the line under the chequered flag.
'And again': he lifts a trophy on the top step.
'And again': a shelf crowded with trophies, the red book among them.
In the boss's office he signs the contract, his dad behind him; then he and the boss shake hands, looking at each other.
Brazil 2008, last lap in the rain: his silver car closes on a slower white car. Fuller Interlagos: stands both sides, boards, light poles, towers, footbridge, city.
Two corners from the end: up the inside, side by side, and through.
Across the line under the chequered flag; his crew in the garage erupt.
Dennis on the pit wall: a slow breath, then a clenched fist pumped in front of his chest.
Callback: the fixed-up kart in the shed, the book on the wall behind it.
The grown driver lifts his helmet off on 'Lewis'; on 'Hamilton' it fades into a real photo of him in November 2008 (CC BY 2.0, Alistair Rickman), held, then cut.
